feat(tactics): elaborate scoped local lemmas and nested proof declarations

Implement named and anonymous have, inferred facts and transparent tactic lets. Parse directly nested by blocks with explicit heap frames; elaborate annotations and values on the existing term worklist. Keep the new name out of its own right-hand side, retain original annotations and unused values as final kernel obligations, and preserve local scopes through cases, induction and dependent substitution.

Twenty new regressions cover actual K1 rejections, nested scope isolation, resource recovery, a 300-level small-stack parser run and the installed CLI. All five affected packages pass locally: 1700 top-level tests, zero failed or ignored; Clippy with warnings denied, workspace all-target compilation and formatting pass. No new axioms, dependencies or checker changes. Remote gates repeat before publication.
